statusDetail: Audit could not proceed beyond recon. The AWS load balancer returned HTTP 403 Forbidden for the entry URL to both headless Chrome and curl (including a mobile browser user agent), so the intended site UI, routes, controls, assets, and representative flows were unavailable.

page.notes: The response body was an AWS ELB 403 error page, not the intended site.

evidenceUsed: curl with desktop and mobile user agents

artifacts.caption: Mobile Chrome capture showing only the 403 Forbidden response
Desktop Chrome capture showing only the 403 Forbidden response
Rendered DOM contains only a 403 Forbidden heading
Layout metrics for the 403 response, not the intended site
Raw and rendered access both returned HTTP 403
Runtime probe confirms title/body are 403 Forbidden and no links exist
curl response headers show HTTP/2 403 from awselb/2.0
Mobile-UA curl response headers also show HTTP/2 403
Mobile-UA curl response body is a 403 error document
robots.txt request returned the same 403 body
sitemap.xml request returned the same 403 body
Atomic 58-check manifest with per-check evidence plans
Pinned Modern Web Guidance catalog consulted before judgement
